answer: Decaying reputation resists sybils: standing is not a permanent jade token minted once, it fades each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work. A fake farm can flash bright for a moment, but its ivory sheen dulls to faded pigment the instant it stops contributing. Attackers must keep every single account productively busy forever, which turns a cheap one-time swarm into a permanent, compounding labor bill they cannot sustain.
